## Database gate
- No migration/schema/entity path changes detected.

## Conflict resolution
- `backend/internal/repository/github_release_service.go`: retained the custom token-file precedence and GitHub redirect allowlist while adopting the official exact-HTTPS API token scope. Metadata and public Release asset API requests use `UPDATE_GITHUB_TOKEN`; direct asset-host requests remain anonymous, and redirects strip authorization before leaving `api.github.com`.
- `deploy/.env.example`: retained the pinned custom production image and added the official `UPDATE_GITHUB_TOKEN` example.
- `frontend/src/api/__tests__/admin.system.rollback.spec.ts`: updated the custom rollback contract test to cover the official 15-minute update/rollback request timeout.
